extracted.intended_audience: public relations and communications professionals, PR/marketing managers measuring press release performance and ROI
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and KPI rubric for evaluating press release performance across distribution, coverage, engagement, awareness, reputation, and business outcomes; includes tracking methods and production practices that correlate with high KPI performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead generation (form fills, sign-ups)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of leads generated that can be attributed to the press release, e.g., form fills or sign-ups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use UTM parameters to track conversions from PR-driven pages and attribute revenue to specific releases; measure lift in leads post-release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Booked meetings
rubrics_metrics.description: Meetings or demo requests booked as a result of the press release activity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track meeting sources via CRM and UTM tags to attribute booked meetings to specific releases or outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sales / conversions (with $ amounts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Revenue-generating conversions directly attributable to the press release, reported in dollar amounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute revenue through UTM tagging and analytics; connect conversions to pipeline records for dollar-amount attribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pipeline impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Effect of the press release on sales pipeline metrics (e.g., opportunities influenced or created).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure pipeline-stage movement and influenced opportunities in CRM tied back to release-driven leads or contacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer acquisition cost reduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Reduction in CAC attributable to press release-driven demand versus other channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare acquisition costs before/after releases and allocate marketing spend when calculating CAC changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revenue attribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to attribute specific revenue to a press release (directly or via influenced touchpoints).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use multi-touch attribution, UTM parameters, and CRM linkage to quantify revenue attributable to releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pickup count (number of placements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of media placements and outlets that ran the press release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure both quantity and cadence (e.g., quick pickup within 24 hours, coverage continuing multiple days).

rubrics_metrics.name: Outlet quality (tier 1/2/3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality and tiering of outlets that pick up the release (e.g., tier 1 national vs. local blogs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Weight pickups by outlet tier when assessing impact;Tier 1 pickups are highlighted as high-value outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Earned Media Value (EMV)
rubrics_metrics.description: Monetary worth of earned placements expressed as equivalent paid advertising value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use EMV as a comparative metric but be aware of methodological differences across tools; combine with qualitative assessment of outlet quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reach (impressions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated audience size or impressions across placements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine reach from distribution platforms and media monitoring tools; consider quality of reach (relevant audiences) not just quantity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Share of Voice (SoV)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proportion of industry/media conversation occupied by the release/topic vs. competitors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use media monitoring tools to calculate SoV and benchmark against competitors during campaign windows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sentiment analysis / Sentiment scores
rubrics_metrics.description: Measure of positive/negative/neutral tone in coverage and mentions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use monitoring tools for sentiment and track changes over time; combine automated sentiment with human review for accuracy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release views
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of views or reads of the press release on distribution platforms or the company site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track via distribution platform analytics and site analytics to understand initial audience consumption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Click-through rate (CTR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of viewers who click links within the release (to site, assets, CTAs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Benchmark: the page suggests >5% CTR as a sign of high distribution-stage performance; use UTM-tagged links to measure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time on page / Page dwell time
rubrics_metrics.description: Average time visitors spend on the press-release page or linked assets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider 'meaningful page dwell time' as an engagement indicator; longer dwell time suggests substantive engagement (e.g., reading, viewing multimedia).

rubrics_metrics.name: Social shares
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of times the release or its coverage is shared on social platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page cites 50+ social shares as an indicative engagement threshold; pre-prepared social amplification can boost shares.

rubrics_metrics.name: Backlinks generated / Quality backlinks
rubrics_metrics.description: Number and quality of links back to company properties from coverage sites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track count and domain authority of citing sites; 5+ quality backlinks is listed as a favorable engagement-stage metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Domain authority of citing sites
rubrics_metrics.description: Authority/quality metric of the domains that link to or cite the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Weight backlinks by domain authority when assessing SEO and referral value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brand mentions
rubrics_metrics.description: Volume of brand mentions across media and social channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure baseline mentions and post-release lift; use monitoring tools to segment by outlet and sentiment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search volume lift
rubrics_metrics.description: Increase in search interest for brand or topic following the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track organic search trends and branded keyword queries as an awareness indicator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Branded keyword rankings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search engine rankings for branded keywords resulting from coverage or SEO effects of the release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor SERP movement for branded terms and correlate with release timing and backlinks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct traffic to site
rubrics_metrics.description: Visitors who reach the site directly (e.g., via brand interest) after a release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare direct traffic changes pre/post-release; direct traffic lift can signal increased awareness and intent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crisis recovery time
rubrics_metrics.description: Time required for reputation metrics to recover after negative news or events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track sentiment and reputation scores over time; faster recovery indicates stronger reputation management performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry rankings
rubrics_metrics.description: Changes in industry lists, leaderboards, or analyst recognition influenced by coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use as a reputation/validation metric; tie specific coverage to ranking changes where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spokesperson quote frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: How often company spokespeople are quoted in coverage following a release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Higher quote frequency implies strong message penetration and journalist engagement; track both frequency and quality of quotes.

rubrics_metrics.name: UTM parameter tracking
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of UTM tags on links in releases and distribution to measure source-specific traffic and conversions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Essential for attributing conversions and revenue to specific releases; include campaign, medium, source, and content tags consistently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution platform analytics
rubrics_metrics.description: Built-in dashboards and data from distribution services (e.g., PR Newswire, Business Wire).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage geographic, demographic, and audience-profile data from platforms to assess reach and distribution effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media monitoring tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Third-party services (Cision, Meltwater, Muck Rack) used to track mentions, sentiment, and competitor coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these tools for cross-channel monitoring, sentiment analysis, and benchmarking against competitors.

rubrics_metrics.name: High open rate (>30%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Open rate for emailed releases/distributions above 30% is considered strong at the distribution stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track email open rates from distribution lists; subject line strength and audience targeting influence open rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quick pickup (within 24 hours)
rubrics_metrics.description: Speed of media pickup; coverage appearing within 24 hours is a favorable distribution outcome.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fast pickup suggests strong news value and effective pitching/distribution timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wide geographic distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage and distribution that reach multiple relevant geographies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess regional vs. national reach depending on release objectives; localization may be necessary for specific markets.

rubrics_metrics.name: 5+ pickups (above industry average)
rubrics_metrics.description: Securing five or more placements is cited as an above-average coverage benchmark.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use pickup count alongside outlet quality; five low-tier pickups differ from one tier-1 pickup in impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tier 1 outlet pickup
rubrics_metrics.description: Placement in a top-tier outlet (national or highly influential publication).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize tier-1 pickups for reach and credibility; they often have outsized impact on awareness and SEO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coverage continues 3+ days
rubrics_metrics.description: Sustained coverage for three or more days signals ongoing news traction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track cadence of mentions and follow-on stories beyond the initial day of release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original quotes used (not just rewrites)
rubrics_metrics.description: Journalists using the release's original quotes indicate high-quality, usable content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original quoting suggests the release was used as-is; it reflects quality writing and relevance to journalists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embed/downloaded multimedia
rubrics_metrics.description: Multimedia assets (images, videos, downloads) being embedded or downloaded from release pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracks engagement beyond text; availability of multimedia increases shareability and time on page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead generation lift (business outcome)
rubrics_metrics.description: Measured increase in lead volume attributable to the release as a business outcome metric.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare lead volumes and conversion rates in defined windows post-release and attribute via UTMs and CRM.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sales attribution (business outcome)
rubrics_metrics.description: Directly attributing sales or influenced sales to the press release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use attribution models and CRM evidence to quantify sales impact attributable to coverage or direct release traffic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brand awareness lift (business outcome)
rubrics_metrics.description: Measured increase in awareness indicators (search, mentions, direct traffic) after a release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine search volume, branded searches, and direct traffic to quantify awareness lift.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reputation score change
rubrics_metrics.description: Quantitative change in composite reputation metrics (sentiment, rankings, share of voice).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track pre/post-release reputation baselines; use monitoring tools and third-party indices where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: News value
rubrics_metrics.description: The intrinsic newsworthiness of the announcement (how legitimate/interesting it is as news).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Genuine news value is listed as a primary driver of top KPI performance; assess timeliness, novelty, and relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific data / findings
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of concrete data, statistics, or findings that make the release reportable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific, attributable data increases pick-up likelihood and journalist confidence; include sources and context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compelling quote
rubrics_metrics.description: A strong, quotable line from an executive or expert that journalists can use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft quotes that add perspective and are concise; compelling quotes increase likelihood of being used verbatim.

rubrics_metrics.name: Good multimedia (production quality)
rubrics_metrics.description: High-quality images, video, or downloadable assets that enhance the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multimedia should be embeddable and optimized for web; increases engagement, shares, and pickup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strong subject line for distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: An effective headline/subject line used in distribution that drives opens and interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subject lines should be concise, news-focused, and targeted to the audience; they materially affect open rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeted distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Sending the release to the right journalists/outlets and audience segments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeting boosts relevance and pickup; combine wire distribution with direct journalist outreach when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: AP-compliant format
rubrics_metrics.description: Release formatted to AP (Associated Press) standards for journalistic ease of use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AP-compliant structure increases usability for reporters and decreases editing friction; include clear dateline, lead, and boilerplate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mobile-friendly structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Release written and formatted for readability on mobile devices (scannable, short paragraphs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mobile-friendly structure improves engagement metrics like time on page and CTR; include concise leads and visible multimedia.

rubrics_metrics.name: SEO-optimized headlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Headlines crafted for search visibility and relevance (including keywords).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optimize headlines for both journalists and search engines; balance SEO with newsworthiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive availability for follow-up
rubrics_metrics.description: Executives or spokespeople being available for journalist follow-up or interviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Availability increases the chance of deeper coverage and follow-on stories; provide clear contact info and windows of availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargo discipline
rubrics_metrics.description: Respecting and managing embargoes when providing advance copies to journalists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proper embargo handling facilitates coordinated coverage timing and trust with journalists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Localization where applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: Customizing messaging, language, or distribution for local markets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Localization increases relevance and pickup in regional outlets; translate or adapt content where necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wire service distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Using wire services (e.g., PR Newswire) to distribute releases broadly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wire distribution extends reach and provides platform analytics; combine with targeted outreach for maximal effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct journalist outreach component
rubrics_metrics.description: Complementing wire distribution with personalized outreach to reporters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct pitches increase chance of tier-1 pickup and original coverage; tailor messages to journalist beats and interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-prepared social amplification
rubrics_metrics.description: Having social posts and amplification assets ready at the time of release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pre-prepared assets enable immediate social engagement and can boost shares and visibility.
